faqs.a: Not always. A code points to a system.

faqs.q: Can you fix warning lights?

faqs.q: Do you reprogram modules?

faqs.q: Will a battery issue affect electronics?

services.name: Alternator Installation & Repair
services.desc: The alternator charges your battery while the engine runs. If your lights dim or a battery warning appears, we test the charging system and repair or replace the alternator.

faqs.q: What are the signs of a bad alternator?
faqs.a: Dim lights, a battery warning light, or dying while driving.

faqs.q: How do I tell it from the battery?
faqs.a: A test tells us. Call us.

faqs.q: Can I drive with a bad alternator?

services.name: Differential Repair

faqs.q: What does a bad differential sound like?
faqs.a: Whining, howling, or clunking, especially in turns.

faqs.q: Does it need fluid changes?
faqs.a: Yes. Check your manual for intervals.

faqs.q: Can I keep driving with a noisy differential?
faqs.a: Risky. Damage can spread.

faqs.q: Do front and rear differentials differ?
faqs.a: Yes. Which you have depends on your drivetrain.

faqs.q: Differential Repair: What causes failure?

services.name: Axles

faqs.q: Signs of a bad axle?
faqs.a: Clicking in turns, vibration, or grease leaks.

faqs.q: Can I drive with a bad CV joint?

faqs.q: Axles: Repair or replace?

faqs.q: Can a bad heater affect my safety?

faqs.q: Why is only one side warm?

faqs.q: Should I fix the heater before winter?
